title: Induction: first week at Kestrel Ridge
summary: Meet the campus, learn how the course works, and get a working mental model of a hyperscale data center: where the power goes, where the heat goes, and how efficiency is measured.
objectives: Explain how a daily Hyperscale session works and why it is built around prediction, retrieval and spacing
Trace electrical power from the utility to the chip and name where it is lost
Trace heat from the chip to the atmosphere, with and without an economizer
Compute PUE, WUE and CUE from facility data and explain what each metric misses
Use the ASHRAE inlet envelope and chiller lift to reason about cooling setpoints
Tune a simulated data hall by hand against a hard inlet-temperature constraint, and explain why total energy, not PUE, is the objective

build.title: Your baseline score
build.summary: Tune the simulated data hall by hand in the Control Room. Your best manual score becomes the baseline your controllers and, in August, your RL agent must beat.
